headline: One-tile corridors and long A* legs under load.
purpose: One-tile corridors with seven cells of rock between them, so the compass cannot see the next corridor through a wall. Isolates long A* legs, corridor following and leg timeout under load.

expected.note: Each leg is at most six tiles, so the serpentine is many decisions. Watch legTimeoutSeconds and frame time: AStar is quadratic in visited nodes.

notes: 1348 wall objects fill every non-corridor cell; they block sight.
A corner cut needs a zero-width gap, which a 1-wide corridor cannot provide; the dedicated Pinch map tests that separately.
Score: arrival, leg count, wall-clock, and whether any leg times out.
